blocks.title: Private cloud
blocks.text: Private cloud sirf ek idara istemal karta hai. Yeh idare ki apni jagah ya teesre fareeq ke paas host ho sakti hai, magar mushtarak nahi hoti.
Bara bank hassas gahak data apne data centres mein, ya provider ki chalayi hui, aisi private cloud mein rakh sakta hai jis tak sirf bank ki pohanch ho.

blocks.prompt: Private cloud public cloud se kaise mukhtalif hai (MCQ 3)?
blocks.explanation: (c) yeh ek idare ke liye makhsoos hai aur data aur hifazat par zyada control deti hai.

items: Private cloud: ek idara, zyada control aur hifazat (bank ka data).
